how: We read the website of every Los Angeles wedding DJ listed on Lazo (83 listings, 65 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: a Bay Area DJ company with a San Dimas listing, a national photo-and-DJ chain, and one-page sites with nothing but a Yelp link. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: What is the venue's sound limit and curfew, and have you played there? Los Angeles hillside and beach venues often cap decibels.
Who exactly is the DJ at my wedding, and can I talk to that person before I sign?
What is in the base price, and what do ceremony sound, uplighting, a photo booth and extra hours add?

picks.name: DJ Kamayo Entertainment| Wedding DJs
picks.blurb: DJ Kamayo got turntables at 15, DJed his own high school prom and held a weekend nightclub residency in Los Angeles while booking weddings. His company has focused on weddings since 2006 and publishes packages for Friday, Saturday and Sunday weddings, with photo booth and DJ bundles.

picks.name: Elegant Music - Beautiful, Successful Weddings & Events
picks.blurb: Eric Zimmermann has provided wedding ceremony music since 1990, from a live quartet to DJ dance music, and works as a professional master of ceremonies. Elegant Music sends each bride a sketch of her wedding itinerary, and covers Malibu, Santa Monica, Long Beach and the rest of Southern California.

picks.name: DJ CeeLos
picks.blurb: Carlos Garcia is a bilingual wedding DJ and MC serving Southern California since 2007. DJ CeeLos plans every detail from the initial consultation to the last dance song, with the pitch that a wedding deserves a DJ who reads the room and guides the celebration, not just plays music.

picks.name: DJ Sota Entertainment
picks.blurb: DJ Sota Entertainment, also known as West Coast Wedding DJs, was established in 2008 and counts more than 1,500 weddings. Services run from ceremony music and officiating through cocktail hour to the reception DJ and emcee, out of Thousand Oaks.

picks.name: Synergy Events
picks.blurb: DJ Wrex mixes live at every Synergy Events booking, with pro sound and full-day coverage as the starting point and MC, ceremony sound and lighting as add-ons. The Los Angeles team has worked since 2001 and lays out its booking in four steps on the site.

picks.name: LB Entertainment
picks.blurb: LB Entertainment was built from packed nightclubs and real residencies, and since 2001 has brought that crowd-reading instinct to weddings across Los Angeles and Orange County. Based in Long Beach, with lighting, photo booths, AV and sound rentals from the same company.

picks.name: DJ Pooya LA
picks.blurb: For 15 years Pooya has DJed Persian, Armenian, Arab, Afghan, Jewish and Indian weddings, more than 300 multicultural weddings across California. Bilingual MC, high-end sound and lighting, and a team of live musicians, with packages that cover ceremony, cocktail hour and reception across three locations.

picks.name: Desi Beat Collective
picks.blurb: Desi Beat Collective is a boutique DJ service for Indian and South Asian weddings, blending traditional and modern music with cultural knowledge. Packages cover the sangeet, the baraat and the reception, with MCs, live music, production and lighting available.

picks.name: Micah Gallardo
picks.blurb: Micah Gallardo hosts with music, drawn to soul, disco, funk and house, and says most couples invest between $3,000 and $4,000 depending on guest count, venue layout and how many spaces need sound. Serves Los Angeles, Long Beach and Orange County from ceremony through the last song.

picks.name: Angels Music Productions
picks.blurb: Angels Music Productions is a DJ, audio visual and event production company in Valley Village that has served Los Angeles weddings since 2015, with its own sound, lighting and backup gear. Packages start at $999, and the company also does LED screens and full production.

picks.name: Honey
picks.blurb: Honey is a boutique DJ and MC agency in Los Angeles that describes its roster as music lovers and tastemakers, with female DJs for weddings, luxury corporate events and private parties. Curated music, thoughtful hosting and production, and the agency also works San Francisco and Nashville.

picks.name: Icon DJ
picks.blurb: Icon DJ is owner-operated by Ethan Stone: you plan with Ethan and Ethan is behind the decks. He learns what you like and what not to play, then watches the room and adjusts, with photo booths, uplighting, LED walls and AV production available on top.
